violation_type.title: Nighttime Requirements - Separate Sleeping and Dressing Areas for Over 6 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.3207(5))
violation_type.short_title: Nighttime Requirements - Separate Sleeping and Dressing Areas for Over 6 Years of Age
violation_type.typical_finding: I observed mixed age group during bedtime however out of the mixed age group two were older than six years old and were not separated from the other children.

finding_variants.text: I observed mixed age group during bedtime however out of the mixed age group two were older than six years old and were not separated from the other children.
Boys and girls were on their mats during sleep time. During inspection this age group were separated. Boys were separated from girls.
